# Evidence recovery and the limits of stop access after interrupted change

<a id="主张-claim"></a>
## Claim

For every partial law and admission, a property holds after every admitted course from every start where it holds exactly when every admitted step keeps it; and counted work finishes in work + 1 ticks exactly when the fuel covers them, no shorter run finishing. The recoverable device is an instance of both. Its histories, interruptions included, are the courses of its admitted steps, so a durable pending description and sequential overwrite steps preserve coherence while incomplete and actual candidate coverage when published across every finite admitted interruption history, exactly because each admitted step does. A pending recovery is counted work: n remaining writes plus publication complete in n + 1 uninterrupted steps exactly when the reserve covers n + 1 units and the deadline n + 1 more steps, and no shorter resumption publishes.

Canonical source: [RecoverableControl.lean](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/universal-ethics/generative-capacity/RecoverableControl.lean)

<a id="前提与对应-hypotheses-and-correspondence"></a>
## Hypotheses and correspondence

- Initial evidence coverage and current read law; the prepared target comes from the preceding permission/generation-checked commit; pending description, consumption state and gate are durable and protected.
- Overwrite semantics, atomic individual write/consumption steps, atomic preparation/publication, no extra writer or concurrent grant change; interruptions retain completed effects and add a specified delay.
- The completion theorem additionally requires sufficient remaining resources, deadline and an uninterrupted suffix; consistency alone does not ensure them.

Actual change, retained recovery grounds and access to action differentiate within one history; Safe denotes evidence coherence, not harmless activity or always-available shutdown.

<a id="检验与边界-validation-and-boundaries"></a>
## Validation and boundaries

Lean 4.29.1 checked 22 new theorems / 48 explicit audits (17 empty, 22 propext only, 8 also Quot.sound, 1 additionally Classical.choice); nine inherited proof modules and one case helper were separately rebuilt. 27,888 same-author finite comparisons passed; full signatures, dependencies and frozen hashes remain, without independent acceptance or hardware trials. General laws: checker receipts bound.

Local recovery and evidential inference, not verification of hardware, compiler, persistence barriers, arbitrary irreversible effects, an independent emergency stop or ethical adequacy. Full intermediate harm is not modeled; universal convergence and zero substantive axioms are not proved.

- With nine units, recovery exhausts after the first actual write while activity remains running and ordinary shutdown is blocked; losing the durable marker can instead expose a false certificate. [RecoverableControl.lean](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/universal-ethics/generative-capacity/RecoverableControl.lean)
- Repeated writes or crash delay make 22 units or a 23-step deadline insufficient; prior consumption remains. [RecoverableControl.lean](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/universal-ethics/generative-capacity/RecoverableControl.lean)
